name: early_move_continuation_novolgate
notes: Sensitivity variant of early_move_continuation (2026-09-25): drops the cum_vol_vs_adv20 >= 0.3 volume gate entirely. Production's live avoid_chase_extended trigger gates on `rvol` (cumulative session volume vs a time-of-day-normalized expected pace, from intraday_volume_profile) rather than cum_vol_vs_adv20 (cumulative volume vs 20-day average DAILY volume) -- a field schema_lab.py's warehouse cannot reproduce exactly. This variant bounds the population with NO volume condition at all, to see how much the volume gate itself is doing versus the price/VWAP/HOD conditions alone.
